name: IVR Leave System - 01 Inbound Call Processor (11-Step Architecture)

parameters.query: SELECT s.*, a.email as advisor_email, a.phone_number as advisor_phone FROM students_parent_directory s LEFT JOIN faculty_advisors a ON s.advisor_id = a.advisor_id WHERE s.parent_phone_number = '={{ $json.callerPhone }}';

INSERT INTO leave_od_requests (roll_no, request_type, start_date, end_date, duration_days, reason, ivr_call_sid, recording_url, status) VALUES ('={{ $json.rollNo }}', '={{ $json.requestType }}', '={{ $json.startDate }}', '={{ $json.endDate }}', {{ $json.durationDays }}, '={{ $json.reason }}', '={{ $json.callSid }}', '={{ $json.recordingUrl }}', 'Pending') RETURNING request_id;

parameters.subject: =NEW {{ $('Validate Caller ID Verification').first().json.requestType }} Request: {{ $('Validate Caller ID Verification').first().json.studentName }} ({{ $('Validate Caller ID Verification').first().json.rollNo }})
